top_signals.title: China Crude Comeback Loses Steam as Iran War Enters Eighth Month
top_signals.summary: A nascent recovery in Chinese oil demand has begun to falter, as continued fighting in the Middle East and limited Iranian supply keep crude prices too high for private refiners, prompting some analysts to trim forecasts for the coming months.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Kenyan Inflation Accelerates to 32-Month High in September
top_signals.summary: Kenyan inflation accelerated to the highest level in more than two and a half years in September, driven by higher energy and food prices.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Microsoft Plugs Nearly 400 Security Holes
top_signals.summary: Microsoft today released updates to remedy at least 398 security vulnerabilities in its Windows operating systems and supported software, including one weakness that is already being actively exploited and two others that were publicly detailed prior to today.

top_signals.summary: Turkey’s President Recep Tayyip Erdogan said the country has created a board to oversee the liquidation of investment funds caught up in a crisis over holdings in illiquid stocks.
